INSERT INTO jeonse_price_indices ( region_id, base_month, price_index, change_rate ) SELECT region.region_id, #{baseMonth}, #{priceIndex}, #{changeRate} FROM regions region WHERE region.region_code = #{regionCode}
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE price_index = VALUES(price_index), change_rate = VALUES(change_rate)
mapper.select:
SELECT child.region_code, child.region_name, parent.region_code AS parent_region_code FROM regions child
INNER JOIN regions parent ON parent.region_id = child.parent_region_id
WHERE child.region_level = 'SIGUNGU' AND parent.region_level = 'SIDO'
ORDER BY child.region_code

SELECT region.region_code, region.region_name, price.price_index, price.change_rate
FROM regions region
LEFT JOIN jeonse_price_indices price ON price.region_id = region.region_id AND price.base_month = #{baseMonth}
WHERE region.region_level = 'SIDO'
ORDER BY region.region_code
